paragraphs: Nutanix sells infrastructure software that lets organizations build, manage and optimize IT across on-premises, edge and public cloud environments. At the core is a platform with hyperconverged compute, storage, virtualization and networking.

The storage layer consolidates file, object and block storage into one platform with integrated cyber security and ransomware protection. A database service automates provisioning, patching, cloning, backup and recovery, and supports Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Day-to-day work happens in Prism, which monitors and manages VMs, storage and networks across on-premises clusters and public clouds from a single console. Prism is included with Nutanix Cloud Infrastructure at no additional cost. For larger estates, Nutanix Central is a cloud console for viewing and managing Nutanix services deployed on-premises or on Nutanix Cloud Clusters.

The home page counts more than 30,000 companies as customers. Public sector examples include the Indonesia Election Committee, which the company says improved legal response times by 90% across 210 million voter records. Another describes London Gatwick Airport scaling support to fifty million passengers. The company also reports being named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant.
